title: A CUDA extension took four failed builds, each hiding the next cause
symptom: Four consecutive build jobs failed for four distinct reasons before the extension imported.
root_cause: pip build isolation (no torch in the build env) -> login-node vs GPU-node difference -> pip filtering the compiler diagnostics out of the log -> GCC 8.5 too old for torch 2.3's headers ('overflow in constant expression' in DispatchKeySet.h).
correction_made: --no-build-isolation on a GPU node, setup.py build_ext invoked directly with output unfiltered, and module load gcc/10.2.0; all three produced modules import under torch 2.3.0+cu121.
